question: Should OpenClaw TUI render live reasoning stream events as transient chat content, footer/status text, or keep the existing `/reasoning on` plus Ctrl+T behavior?
rationale: The reporter specifically asked for OpenAI/Grok-style line rewriting and later footer/status placement, which is a product UX choice beyond the backend stream plumbing.

options.title: Transient chat stream
options.body: Render `stream: "thinking"` as a transient/updating chat item during the run, then clear, collapse, or replace it when final answer text arrives.

options.title: Footer/status stream
options.body: Show the latest reasoning delta in the running footer/status area and clear it when the run finalizes.

options.title: History only
options.body: Document the supported `/reasoning on` plus Show Thinking path and leave OpenAI/Grok-style live rewriting out of scope for now.

recommendation.title: Transient chat stream
recommendation.body: Render `stream: "thinking"` as a transient/updating chat item during the run, then clear, collapse, or replace it when final answer text arrives.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced `/reasoning` visibility and has the strongest history-backed ownership signal for the TUI UX contract.
